name: dataflow
description: Visual data flows: core (TS engine), server (Bun: api, supervisor, workers) and perf (engine performance scenarios, bun run perf). POC_v0/ is the proof of concept, kept for reference.

scripts.test: bun test --cwd=dataflow.core && bun test --cwd=dataflow.server && bun test --cwd=dataflow.editor && bun test --cwd=dataflow.perf
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd=dataflow.core typecheck && bun run --cwd=dataflow.server typecheck && bun run --cwd=dataflow.editor typecheck && bun run --cwd=dataflow.perf typecheck
